title: Student aid checks worth $20,361 still lacked proof of clearance

beats.text: A San Francisco institute had issued 29 student aid checks that remained uncashed.

visual.sub: The institution held federal aid intended for students

beats.text: They were more than 120 days old and totaled $33,347.
The college contacted students and reported several ways the checks could be resolved.

visual.kicker: Management reported three dispositions in progress

beats.text: It said $6,965 would go back to financial aid.
The next audit asked what had actually cleared the bank.

visual.kicker: The later auditor traced seven cleared checks

beats.text: Seven students had cleared checks totaling $12,986.

visual.kicker: The later auditor traced seven cleared checks

beats.text: That left $20,361 without proof of clearance.
The auditors reported the control corrected and found no further old checks in their sample.

visual.kicker: The later auditor traced seven cleared checks

beats.text: The September 2020 federal decision concerned a different audit year.

visual.kicker: The federal decision cited the following year concerned another audit
visual.text: Which year did the letter cover?

beats.text: The final disposition of the remaining checks is still unverified.

visual.kicker: The federal decision cited the following year concerned another audit
